mutationCampaign.verdict: All 5 rows discriminate: every mutation killed exactly one row, and every row was killed by exactly one mutation (a 1:1 kill matrix). No row survived the whole campaign, so no row is dead weight.
mutationCampaign.assertionLevelCaveat: Within each of the 4 guard rows the helper also asserts `expect(projected).toBeUndefined()` ('nothing projected'). That assertion is NOT independently mutation-killable: the builder has no partial-return path, so any mutation that leaves the throw intact also leaves the assignment unreached. Each guard row's actual killer is the message-matched `toThrow`. This is recorded rather than claimed as proven, and the test file's helper comment says the same.
